name: github-deep-dive
description: Assess a current GitHub project through docs, releases, code activity, issues, PRs, forks, and maintenance signals.
---
# GitHub deep dive

Inspect repository documentation, license, releases, commits, branches, PRs, issues, discussions, forks, contributors, and project health. Distinguish maintained feature, experiment, roadmap, and community fork. Note exact revision/date where practical.

Do not infer support from star count. Exit with capability, maturity, adoption risk, and primary links.
